headline: Donita Rodriguez Appointed as New Member of Peru's Fiscal Council
summary: Donita Rodriguez, chief macroeconomic analyst at Apoyo Consultoría, was appointed as a new member of Peru's Fiscal Council.
why: Fiscal council appointments influence independent fiscal oversight, debt sustainability monitoring, and macroeconomic policy credibility in Peru.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Independent fiscal oversight supports macroeconomic stability.
